hypothesis: Does the existing CA family show finite-budget advantage on label-dependent within-cell RNA/ATAC covariance versus fair non-attention comparators?
scenario: one fixed S7 covariance scenario; no guaranteed CA winner

generation.feature_selection: reuse label-free hash ranking select_features; pair sorted selected columns as artificial channels, not genomic matches
generation.fake_labels: fake_donor_labels with tag prospective-s7:<generator_seed>; balance within original disease strata; never train on real disease labels
generation.equation: For each donor/channel generate independent Gaussian vectors z,w using SHA256(seed,donor_id,channel) stable seed. Centre z,w; scale z to population variance 1; orthogonalize w against z then centre/scale w to variance 1. Replace selected RNA channel by z and ATAC channel by (2*y_d-1)*rho*z + sqrt(1-rho*rho)*w. Leave other transformed columns unchanged. Handle <4 cells or degenerate vectors by explicit refusal.
generation.interpretation: Both planted channel means zero and variances one per donor at all rho; rho controls signed cross-view covariance. Synthetic latent normalization uses only newly generated noise for that donor, not fitted real-feature transforms. Equal moments do not prove equality of all finite-sample marginals; single-view controls check leakage.
generation.row_identity: generate in stable saved cell_id order, restore fold tensor order; donor/channel latent draws must not depend on fold number or observed feature values
generation.test_pairing_shuffle: permute ATAC rows within each held-out donor, fixed seeds, preserve exact marginal row multiset; do not shuffle across labels/donors

training.model_seed: equal generator seed in every arm; seed before constructing model
training.selection: same inner-validation donor log-loss and identical available training budget for neural arms; no hyperparameter sweep
training.param_match: CA/TC within 10%; calculate before fitting and refuse mismatch unless deterministic label-free matching is declared before fits

confirmation.label_split_and_model_seeds: fresh generator tag/model seed per trial; split seed fixed; log all donor sets and labels

evaluation.donor_prediction: mean held-out cell probability; threshold fixed 0.5; 5 disjoint outer folds pooled once per trial; also report mean-fold BA/AUROC to expose pooling effects

bootstrap.invalid_draws: count/report single-class draws; never silently redraw; insufficient valid draws (<950) => incomplete

evaluation.joint_success: estimate >=0.07 AND 95% CI lower >0, not merely CI excludes zero; no negative contrast detection counted as success
evaluation.compare_every_baseline: report paired contrasts to each non-attention arm; screen CA_favoured requires gap>=0.07 against best non-attention; confirmation all-baseline success also requires joint success against every baseline. Joint all-baseline claim is intersection-union; rho .5 is descriptive only.
evaluation.null_check: at rho=0 all complete-arm pooled donor BA in [0.35,0.65]; failure means invalid null/control design, not a favourable method claim
evaluation.marginal_check: at rho=1 logreg_rna and logreg_atac donor BA <=0.60; failure means potential marginal/background shortcut; refuse pairing-only interpretation
evaluation.synthetic_reliability: report CA-TC and all-baseline joint successes / 10 and Wilson 95% intervals; >=8/10 only exploratory conditional screen, never established biological power

pairing_pc.retain_models: CA+TC all screen folds for rho=1; CA+TC confirmation folds if run; checkpoint weights, architecture, synthetic/fold seeds, train transform provenance and split/feature hashes; verify reload reproduces predictions
pairing_pc.identity: repeat same inputs produces identical eval outputs within atol=1e-6
pairing_pc.drop_metric: mean donor log-loss(shuffled)-original; average shuffle outcomes within donor, then paired donor-bootstrap CI; CI lower>0 required; report BA drop but do not choose metric posthoc
pairing_pc.diagnostic_even_if_no_CA_advantage: may evaluate already fitted screen checkpoints and export diagnostic outcome; no additional confirmation fits after screen failure

resources.failures: at most two source/harness repairs; completed result fits immutable; scientific negative triggers no new variant
resources.resumption: persist fit ledger outside rollback; reuse exact config/input/source hashes and complete fit IDs; changed fitting source after outcomes => label run invalid, preserve prior data and stop; never mix predictions across implementations

scope.allow: implementation, meaningful tests, bounded synthetic fits, checkpoint interventions, confirmation if eligible, gate reports and local commits
